corrections.recipe_change: The 17 Nov correction added an explicit pip install of lxml h5py pysam. At 58ad410 requirements.txt lists all three, so the guide uses it as written.
corrections.upstream_reply: No maintainer reply on issue #53, which was still open on 2026-11-19. It has two user comments: the reporter added on 2024-04-02, "For running `precompute_embeddings.py` two more packages are missing: h5py and pysam", and another user wrote on 2025-02-14, "I had the same errors". Commit 58ad410 (PR #79, merged 2026-11-18) added h5py, pysam and lxml to requirements.txt, with numpy<2 and setuptools<81; the PR says it "adds dependencies needed by the tested workflow".
corrections.what_was_wrong: requirements.txt at ac6e80c omitted lxml (needed by scripts/download_bend.py) and h5py and pysam (needed by scripts/precompute_embeddings.py), so pip install -r requirements.txt as the README says stopped at the download step.

corrections.recipe_change: The 17 Nov correction fetched the checkpoints with curl from share f6hdp1zTzh and renamed the folders to the names embed.yaml expected. At 58ad410 embed.yaml points resnetlm at pretrained_models/convnet/ and awdlstm at pretrained_models/awd_lstm/, and the embedders download the checkpoints themselves when those folders are missing, so the guide drops the curl loop. The precompute explanation names download_model with destination_dir for anyone fetching ahead of time; its default destination_dir writes into ./pretrained_models/ directly.
corrections.upstream_reply: Fixed by the maintainer in PR #79, merged 2026-11-18 as commit 58ad410; issue closed the same day. Maintainer's reply on issue #78, 2026-11-18T16:19:32Z: "Thank you for letting us know and identifying the old share and directory mismatch. The fix should be on main now. However, the pretrained_models/resnetlm directory is still empty. It appears there has been a duplication and naming mismatch at some point and that the (Dilated) ResNet from the paper is actually in the folder pretrained_models/convnet. I apologise for the confusion. I have tested the automatic download as well as the download script and they both appear to work now. Please let me know if you still have issues. Then I will reopen the issue." The maintainer's only comment on PR #79, 2026-11-18T16:17:51Z: "Looks fine but then again I am approving my own PR", followed by a shrug emoji. PR #79 says the full benchmark and GPU execution were not tested.
corrections.what_was_wrong: At ac6e80c, download_model in bend/utils/download.py fetched from share dbQM0pgSlM and the README linked share eXAmVvbRSW; both returned 403. The checkpoints were in the data share, but under pretrained_models/convnet and pretrained_models/awd_lstm, while embed.yaml expected pretrained_models/resnetlm and pretrained_models/awdlstm.

corrections.recipe_change: The gene-finding download uses share aNQa0Oz2lY, as download_bend.py and the README do at 58ad410.
corrections.store_note: No store field held a share ID before (the store guide called download_bend.py), so this has no claim of its own. It is recorded in the rationales of bend-recipe-corrections-20261119-gene-finding-download and bend-recipe-corrections-20261119-checkpoint-links.
corrections.what_was_wrong: At ac6e80c the share differed by file: scripts/download_bend.py used f6hdp1zTzh; download_model in bend/utils/download.py used dbQM0pgSlM (403); the README Embedders table (lines 72-73) linked eXAmVvbRSW (403); the README data links (lines 18 and 48) already used aNQa0Oz2lY. Commit 58ad410 moved download_bend.py, download_model and the README model links to aNQa0Oz2lY. The 17 Nov recipe on #71 used f6hdp1zTzh, the download script's share, although the README already linked aNQa0Oz2lY for data; that choice was ours. f6hdp1zTzh still returned 200 on 19 Nov 2026.

corrections.recipe_change: The install step keeps its two pip commands and downloads only the four gene-finding inputs with curl, in place of python scripts/download_bend.py.
corrections.what_was_wrong: Our guide ran python scripts/download_bend.py, which downloads the whole share (about 7.25 GB, including the 3.2 GB GRCh37 FASTA used only by chromatin accessibility). Gene finding needs about 3.51 GB.

Our precompute step copied the README example task=gene_finding,enhancer_annotation. The guide only trains gene finding, and the gene-finding-only download has no enhancer data, so that step would fail on the second task.
